compute_contract.optimization_search_role: CuPy is mandatory; fail closed when CUDA/CuPy is unavailable
compute_contract.equality: selected candidate coefficients and inverse leaves must equal the CPU reference byte-for-byte
compute_contract.telemetry_policy: record CUDA-event timings and sampled device memory; never infer missing values

scope.purpose: mechanism closure for reversible tree lifting and exact finite coding
scope.claim: synthetic unit test only; no model-source gain claim

tree.topology: unique iterative balanced adjacent-pair tree after serialized leaf permutation
tree.odd_lane_rule: carry the last lane unchanged to the next level
tree.permutation: lexicographic Lehmer rank, unsigned big-endian, minimum byte length implied by lane_count
tree.selector: three bits per internal node: swap, predict coefficient p in {0,1}, update coefficient u in {0,1}
tree.selector_order: finest to coarsest, left to right within each level
tree.coefficient_order: root first; details coarsest to finest; row-major vectors then nodes within a level

lifting.forward: optional swap; d=(y-p*x) mod A; c=(x+u*d) mod A
lifting.inverse: x=(c-u*d) mod A; y=(d+p*x) mod A; undo swap

probability_model.state: base-A residue accumulators, reset every 32 detail coefficients
probability_model.contexts: one root context plus body/check contexts derived only from detail position modulo 32
probability_model.fit: Laplace-one counts followed by exact largest-remainder Q16 quantization
probability_model.decode_probabilities: literal uint16 frequency rows summing exactly to 65536
probability_model.transition: fixed public modular accumulator rule; no fitted hidden transition

finite_coder.separation: the reference stream proves finite roundtrip and byte accounting; it is not presented as the proposed 256-way production rANS
finite_coder.termination: meaningful bit length plus zero byte tail is literal in each frame

container.layout: global header, one page-rounded model, then one page-rounded contiguous frame per synthetic expert
container.cold_rule: global header pages plus model pages plus selected expert frame pages
container.physical_rate: eight times complete container bytes divided by literal leaf-symbol count
container.tail_rule: all alignment and arithmetic tail bits must be zero and are charged

synthetic_source.transformed_root: iid uniform and independent for every vector
synthetic_source.structured_details: uniform body symbols followed by residue-class modular checks in every public block of 32
synthetic_source.matched_control: iid uniform detail symbols with identical alphabet and uniform marginals
synthetic_source.long_range: all suffixes through depth 25 for GF2 and 28 for Z4 omit at least one independent check input
synthetic_source.interpretation: a mechanism fixture deliberately constructed to be visible after tree lifting; never evidence about weights

early_kill.exact_roundtrip: mandatory for every adversarial dimension and both alphabets
early_kill.independent_reencode: complete container bytes must match exactly
early_kill.cold_read: must be below 2x for the canonical large synthetic fixture

allowed_decoder_inputs: serialized permutation rank and lifting selectors
forbidden: model, checkpoint, layer, or expert identity as a hidden key
source weights or untransmitted fitted values
